title: Exam configuration
description: The single source of truth for everything exam-specific outside the content files: names, links, exam format, storage key, legacy names and content targets. Read by the app, vite.config.ts and the scripts.

todo.description: Open setup tasks (new-app.mjs leaves them here); npm run validate warns while any remain. Delete each entry once done.

title.description: Official exam title; keep the English title in both languages unless Microsoft publishes a localized one.

appName.description: Name in the header, the document title and the install dialog, e.g. "AZ-104 Prep".

shortName.description: Short name under the home-screen icon.

badge.description: Text in the logo badge and the app icons, e.g. "104".

storageKey.description: localStorage key for the learner's progress; changing it starts every learner from scratch.

defaultLang.description: Language of the UI and the content until the learner switches.

skillsOutlineDate.description: Date of the study guide's "Skills measured as of …" version the outline follows.

courseNumber.description: Official course number, e.g. AZ-104T00; empty when the exam has no course.

codeLanguage.description: Language of the code samples and code questions, shown on code blocks. "Python" gets syntax highlighting; anything else is shown as plain text.

minutes.description: Exam time of the full simulation.

passPercent.description: The app's pass guideline in percent of points (the real exam reports a scaled score).

seatMinutes.description: Optional seat time of the real exam (exam time plus agreements and survey), shown with the exam-day facts on Resources.

feedback.description: Feedback links on questions, lesson sections, diagrams, code samples and cards open a prefilled issue in the app's repository.

issuesUrl.description: "New issue" address of the app's public GitHub repository, e.g. https://github.com/owner/repo/issues/new. Empty: the app shows no feedback links.

official.description: Optional further official Microsoft pages for this exam, e.g. the certification page or an exam prep video, listed under Official from Microsoft on Resources.

community.description: Optional non-official material, shown in its own section on Resources.

toneLabels.description: Optional exam-specific names for diagram tones in the legend, e.g. platform: Foundry platform.

legacyNames.description: Renamed or retired product names the validator rejects unless the text frames them as former names.

current.description: The current name to use instead.

sourceDocsets.description: Doc set label per Learn path prefix (without locale); source links read "<label>: <page title>".

minQuestions.description: Questions the bank must hold (content test).

minPerBullet.description: Fewer primary questions on a skills-outline bullet is a validator warning.

minPerModule.description: Fewer questions in a module is a validator warning.

minCases.description: Case studies the bank must hold (content test).

domainShareTolerance.description: Percentage points a domain's share of the bank may fall below the lower end of its official weight (content test).

title.description: Link text; a plain string when it is the same in both languages (an official title).

url.description: An https URL, or empty while unknown.
